records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Total revenue for the three months ended June 30, 2022, increased $38.8 million, or 13%, as compared to the same period in 2021.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: We derive a majority of our revenues from domestic operations and believe we have large opportunities for growth in international markets, as well as continued expansion domestically in the United States.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: We leverage the growth in transaction volumes through the licensing of new systems to customers whose older systems cannot handle increased volume, through the sale of capacity upgrades to existing customers, and through the scalability of our platform-based solutions.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Total operating expenses for the three months ended June 30, 2022, increased $29.7 million, or 10%, as compared to the same period in 2021.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The decrease in total liquidity is primarily attributable to $14.4 million of payments to purchase property and equipment and software and distribution rights, $21.2 million of repayments on the Term Loans, and $62.7 million for stock repurchases, partially offset by positive operating cash flows of $67.8 million.
